notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.notes: Next update 1.04 will fix other gameplay bugs and support Xbox controllers. Due to the work on the new 3D project and the end of long-term support of this title, the price is [b]permanently lowered[/b]. Enjoy.

notes.title: Update to version 1.03 with new features
notes.notes:
With new update comes new features too. Try to finish the battle for our solar system with new game modes. If Simulation mode is too hard for you, try ARCADE mode for new players !

NEWS - update to version 1.03
- UI scaling up to 4K
- Simulation mode added 
- Arcade mode added 
- PS4 controller support added
- autosave modified for arcade and simulation mode
- loading from last checkpoint in dead screen menu

notes.title: Promotional discount !
notes.notes: We invite everyone to enjoy our game. Game is constantly improving and new features are added. We have prepared a discount for you from 27 January to 10 February. Write us suggestions, comments and look forward to you. Thank you. Your PM Team.
